title: RBI Revamps Lead Bank Scheme: Mandates 1 Exclusive LDM Per District
summary: Formalises Block Level Bankers' Committee (BLBC) as credit planning foundation.

blocks.content: Formalises Block Level Bankers' Committee (BLBC) as credit planning foundation.

items: Exclusive LDM: Mandates every lead bank to appoint an exclusive Lead District Manager (LDM) per district.
BLBC Role: Formalises Block Level Bankers' Committee (BLBC) as foundation of district credit planning.
Meeting Timelines: Prescribes uniform meeting schedules for BLBC, DCC, DLRC, and SLBC.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Lead Bank Scheme introduced in 1969 based on Gadgil & Nariman Committee recommendations.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
